item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-0dd6393b5cba82a7","start_unit":1,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A secret military-intelligence unit used Pegasus to monitor human-rights defender Raymundo Ramos in 2020; the resulting information concerned reporting on alleged military extrajudicial killings, and the report recommended giving it confidentially to a military police investigation without adding it to the case file. The report characterized Ramos as linked to organized crime despite his documented rights-defense work.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","7B.9","8B.6","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The conduct occurred in 2020, but was publicly documented and attributable to the López Obrador administration in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report identifies the conduct as occurring during López Obrador's administration; direct presidential authorization is not established in these units.","limitations":["The source is investigative journalism based partly on hacked military records and forensic analysis; it does not establish López Obrador's personal order."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0dd6393b5cba82a7","start_unit":4,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The military intelligence report was addressed to Defense Secretary Luis Cresencio Sandoval, who had direct hierarchical responsibility for the relevant intelligence staff and had received information from the operation. The CMI was described as operating outside the public regulatory structure and using private-communications interception without an identified judicial authorization; the CNDH concluded excessive use of force in the underlying Nuevo Laredo case, and no military personnel had been sanctioned by the report date.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","4B.4","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.5","8B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The underlying events were 2020-2021, with the accountability status reported in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The evidence supports senior-defense-chain awareness and responsibility; it does not prove personal presidential direction.","limitations":["The article reports absence of sanctions as of publication and does not establish the complete later disposition of all investigations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cc6d36d860eb06c8","start_unit":5,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"A scholarly-press biography describes López Obrador's political style as strongly personalized and messianic, emphasizing direct mass communication, moralized conflict with opponents, reliance on personal judgment, and a tendency to treat scrutiny and institutional constraints as attacks on his mission. It also reports earlier social programs, public works, and austerity claims, alongside criticism that transparency was rejected and city problems remained unresolved.","question_ids":["3B.3","4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.5","4B.6","4B.10","5B.1","5B.7","6B.1","6B.2","7B.1","7B.2","7B.6","7B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.4","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The evidence concerns López Obrador's earlier political career and provides background relevant to 2023, not direct 2023 observations.","ruler_attribution":"The book attributes the described political style and earlier conduct to López Obrador.","limitations":["This is a 2007 biography and cannot by itself establish conduct, outcomes, or institutional effects in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-45ecea1b6d03e5ea","start_unit":60,"end_unit":64,"fact_summary":"In December 2023 López Obrador inaugurated only a partially completed 290-mile section of the Maya Train. The project had experienced hours-long passenger delays, only one side of the planned double track was finished, the projected cost had risen from about $8.5-$8.6 billion to as much as $28 billion, and the president acknowledged that the exact construction cost was unknown and that operating-cost coverage could take three or four years.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.4","4B.9","5B.1","5B.3","5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns the project's status and presidential statements in December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"López Obrador inaugurated the project and acknowledged its incompleteness and uncertain cost; implementation was conducted through the federal government and army.","limitations":["The article reports project concerns and estimates but does not provide a full audited cost or final long-term outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-45ecea1b6d03e5ea","start_unit":63,"end_unit":64,"fact_summary":"The Maya Train route crossed environmentally sensitive jungle and cave systems; environmentalists and archaeologists raised concerns about damage to caves, underground rivers, and archaeological remains. The administration used a national-security rationale to exempt the project from normal permitting, public reporting, and environmental-impact procedures, after a 2021 decree requiring automatic approval for projects designated in the national interest or involving national security.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.2","4B.4","4B.6","4B.9","5B.4","5B.6","5B.7","6B.5","6B.8","7B.2","7B.7","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The permitting and construction practices were in force during the 2023 inauguration period.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes the exemption strategy to López Obrador's administration and quotes his national-security rationale.","limitations":["The source reports objections and risk claims; it does not establish the ultimate magnitude of environmental damage."]},{"source_id":"SRC-37a545b05725ecdd","start_unit":4,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"A 2022 academic article describes MORENA as centered on López Obrador's leadership, while also reporting that its internal life remained incompletely institutionalized, that candidate-selection decisions generated ideological skepticism, and that statutory funding for political training was not being delivered as required.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.5","4B.10","7B.5","7B.8","8B.1","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The evidence is from 2018-2022 and offers institutional background for assessing 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes MORENA's leadership-centered structure and political strategy to López Obrador and the party organization.","limitations":["The article is interpretive and predates the end of 2023; it does not independently document all party practices."]},{"source_id":"SRC-37a545b05725ecdd","start_unit":10,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"The article documents a stated López Obrador program centered on reducing inequality, expanding social rights, strengthening the state in strategic sectors, direct social transfers, and universal health and education commitments. It reports constitutional and legislative changes including social-rights reforms, austerity, mandate revocation, popular consultation, outsourcing restrictions, and a ban on tax forgiveness; it also reports the administration's claim that social programs reached 23 million families during the pandemic.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","6B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The program and reforms span 2018-2021 and are relevant as the governing program entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes the program, reforms, and stated social-policy objectives to López Obrador's government.","limitations":["The source reports official claims and policy descriptions, not a complete independent evaluation of 2023 outcomes or distributional effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a905828b01209ed9","start_unit":34,"end_unit":42,"fact_summary":"A thesis analyzing López Obrador's 2018 Twitter campaign found 245 campaign tweets, with the largest categories being political encouragement and visits/acts; commitments and programs comprised 10.7%, accusations 9.2%, and cabinet information 2.0%. Activity increased from 0.59 messages per day in the pre-campaign to 2.3 during the campaign, while no tweets were recorded on election day and five were posted the following day.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The evidence concerns the 2017-2018 campaign and is contextual rather than a direct 2023 measure.","ruler_attribution":"The thesis analyzes López Obrador's verified account and campaign communications.","limitations":["The study covers the 2018 election, not presidential communication or findings."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0428dd462adca88","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Mexico's electoral tribunal unanimously confirmed the 2022 Aguascalientes gubernatorial result for the opposition coalition after Morena challenged spending, campaign inequality, and violence claims; it found no spending-cap violation, no proven coercion at university events, and no generalized violence sufficient to invalidate the election.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.8","6B.7","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The decision is from September 2022 and provides recent institutional context entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The ruling concerns Morena's challenge, not a direct presidential decision; it demonstrates an independent electoral adjudication adverse to the governing party's claim.","limitations":["The document does not establish López Obrador's personal response to the ruling or broader 2023 electoral conditions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-83fb76ce9917da4f","start_unit":1,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The federal legislature's review of the 2022 public account reported revenues above budget, spending of 7.595 trillion pesos, debt below the authorized amount and lower than the prior year as a share of GDP, and completion of 2,153 audits. The Superior Audit Office identified 32.894 billion pesos in recoveries, including 29.766 billion still probable or requiring clarification, and instructed continued legal responsibility procedures and stronger internal controls.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","5B.10","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","7B.9","7B.10","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The decree was issued in February 2025 but reviews fiscal execution in 2022, providing retrospective evidence relevant to the administration's pre-2023 fiscal and audit environment.","ruler_attribution":"The account concerns the federal executive's fiscal administration under López Obrador's government, while the legislature and audit office performed independent review.","limitations":["The supplied document is not a 2023 report and does not establish whether all identified amounts were ultimately recovered or clarified."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0005ac25154e0dc0","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In October 2023 Amnesty International reported that Mexican authorities' handling of the Ayotzinapa investigation impeded truth, justice, and reparation: SEDENA refused to provide key intercepted-communications records to the independent expert group, the expert group departed after lack of cooperation, the former special prosecutor resigned after alleging interference, and López Obrador supported the army while criticizing victim organizations and publicly investigating the former prosecutor. Amnesty also reported Pegasus surveillance of a victim-rights organization in April 2023.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","7B.10","8B.5","8B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns developments reported in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Amnesty directly attributes support for the army, criticism of victim organizations, and public criticism of the former prosecutor to López Obrador; SEDENA's refusal and the investigation failures are attributed to state authorities.","limitations":["The source is an advocacy organization's assessment; the extract does not include the government's full response or the complete evidentiary record."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are historical or methodological rather than 2023-specific; their facts are retained only as qualified background.","The extracts for SRC-2e28dead34ba8bde, SRC-a61c86b24d34dbc2, and SRC-7b2a4f811d2d5480 contain no substantive document content beyond headers or placeholders."]}
